meaning: Independently hosted archival-history metadata from the PhilPapers Foundation, distinct from manuscript declarations and Git timestamps. The services are related, not independent replications. History records associate a title/author/version with an upload date; inaccessible version downloads prevent exact byte binding to repository copies. They do not establish priority over all external work or validate scientific claims.
